contributions.detail: DELTA OF EXACTLY 150.00, CAUSE TRACED ON THE PAGE. Eight donors are itemized and sum to 10,400.00. Form A's printed TOTAL is 10,250 and the cover's line-1 THIS REPORT cell is the same 10,250 - the two printed anchors agree with each other and disagree with the rows. The cause is visible: the FIRST SEVEN rows alone sum to exactly 10,250, and the eighth (Brad Stucki, 150) is the row whose amount the filer wrote one grid line LOW, on the wrapped continuation of his address, with a dash in that line's date cell and a pen stroke through its name cell. The filer's own total omits it. Both figures are retained verbatim, no row is adjusted, and needs_review is set on every row of the side per contract. SCOPE: the schedule's printed total equals the cover's THIS cell (10,250), not the cumulative (20,633), so the schedule is PER-PERIOD - a different scope from what this module publishes. SUB-$50 TRAP CHECKED: the cover's line-2 '$50.00 or less' cells each carry a bare horizontal DASH, which under the repo zero-glyph ruling is BLANK, not zero - so the anchors record "" and Form A is scored against line 1 alone, as required.

expenditures.detail: Seven rows sum to EXACTLY 1,658.18 = Form B's printed TOTAL = the cover's line-3 THIS cell = its CUMULATIVE cell. The THIS and CUMULATIVE cells coincide because the line-3 LAST cell is 0 (this filer reported no expenses in any earlier report of the cycle), so the two scopes coincide here even though the CONTRIBUTIONS side of the same cover is mid-cycle with a LAST of 10,383 - recorded cumulative per the addendum, with the coincidence stated.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: 8 rows sum 10,400.00 vs printed TOTAL 10,250 - WILL NOT GATE, delta 150.00, cause traced above; both figures reported, no row adjusted. p3: 7 rows sum 1,658.18 = printed TOTAL 1,658.18, EXACT.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py reports geometry_status 'gaps' on BOTH pages of this dense ~40-line generation-3 grid (35 bands on p2, 36 on p3, against a true rule pitch of 1.73% of page height) - it drops at least the rule under the header on both pages and one interior rule at ~23.1% on p2, the known open [DEBT]. The grid was therefore mapped by hand against the ink: header = [12.41,14.38], data row N = [14.38+1.73(N-1), 14.38+1.73N]. Under that map every ink line lands cleanly inside one band, and the geometry proof below confirms the map. p2: 8 named donors on data rows 1-8, plus data row 9 which holds only the wrap of row 8's address and row 8's amount. p3: 7 inked data rows 1-7, row 8 empty.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: crop of the first row's amount box (pct 76.00,14.38,8.10,1.73) renders '2000.00'; crop of the LAST amount-bearing box (pct 76.00,28.39,8.10,1.70) renders '150'; control one row-pitch below (y 30.09) renders EMPTY. p3: first-row crop (pct 75.45,14.38,15.15,1.73) renders '281.20'; last-row crop (pct 75.45,24.93,15.15,1.73) renders '148.06' = line 7 (Costco); control one pitch below (y 26.66) renders EMPTY. An intermediate mis-aimed p3 crop rendered line 4's 27.52 and was corrected - the recorded coordinates are the ones that proved out.
gates.balance_chain: Line-1 cover arithmetic closes EXACTLY: 10,383 + 10,250 = 20,633. Line-3 closes exactly: 0 + 1,658.18 = 1,658.18. THE BALANCE LINE DOES NOT CLOSE EXACTLY: 20,633 - 1,658.18 = 18,974.82, and the cover's line-4 cumulative cell prints 18,975 - an 0.18 rounding by the filer, who works in whole dollars on the cover (10,383 / 10,250 / 20,633 all carry no cents) while the schedules carry cents. Reported, not corrected. The line-4 LAST and THIS cells are left blank by the filer. No other filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run against the 10,383 brought forward.

notes: index.csv says 'Kenneth Adam Snow' / 'Commission Seat C'; the form's 'Full Name of Candidate' reads Kenneth Adam Snow and its 'Office' line reads simply 'Commission' - THE SEAT LETTER 'C' IS NOT ON THE DOCUMENT, and the form adds the printed line 'This office includes all areas of Washington County.' A county office, in scope. FORM GENERATION 3 (the same 'WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE / FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT' print as chunk document 05e7e8d7, numbered cover lines 1-4, ~40 ruled schedule lines, an In Kind? column on Form A, a printed TOTAL line on each schedule and page footers 'Page 1/2/3') - neither of the addendum's two described generations. Reporting period beginning 10/28/24, ending 12/31/24; signed 12/31/24; clerk RECEIVED stamp JAN 06 2025. CONTRADICTION WORTH A HUMAN LOOK: contribution lines 1 and 2 are dated 10-22-24 and 10-24-24, BEFORE the certified period beginning of 10/28/24; transcribed verbatim from the form, not adjusted. Privacy: the cover prints the candidate's street address, city, ZIP, personal email and phone, and Form A's address column carries a full street address or PO box plus ZIP for all eight donors - ALL DISCARDED at read time; only the city and state tokens the filer wrote are kept. This filer's hand renders 'UT' with a V-like U throughout; it is transcribed as UT, the only state he writes. THE IN KIND COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW - blank is NOT 'N' on this form, so in_kind is false by absence of any mark and that is noted per row. CALIBRATION-SPECIMEN CANDIDATE: a clean example of a schedule whose printed total silently omits its last row because the filer wrote that amount on the address-wrap line - a defect no single-figure check catches and one the row-count gate alone would also miss. AFTER-THE-FACT CROSS-DOCUMENT NOTE: this filing is a CROSS-CHANNEL RE-POST - its three pages are PIXEL-IDENTICAL (200 dpi full-page difference: mean 0.0, max 0) to pages 4-6 of chunk document 0e7cbe0e (raw/live_wp/2024-Adam-Snow.pdf), where the same report is stapled as report_no 2 of a three-report bundle. Per addendum §D both are transcribed and neither is skipped; the module should flag the pair downstream. That bundle also shows that the two contributions on lines 1-2 here (Washington County RP 2,000 and Steve Studdert 250) were ALREADY itemized on the filer's preceding report (period 6/18/2024-10/28/2024), so the same 2,250.00 is reported twice across consecutive periods, with the Studdert date differing (10/15/2024 there, 10-24-24 here). Both faces transcribed verbatim; nothing suppressed.
